body.p: (task 0.5). holds: sxml_string is a UTF-8 byte view with an flag and a codepoint count. Both are computed in the same pass that validates the bytes (sxml_string_from_utf8), so "cached on first use" is "computed at construction", with no extra pass and no mutable cache in a value type. is_ascii == false makes no claim, so a zero-initialized sxml_string is a valid empty string. Validation is strict (Unicode 16.0 §3.9 table 3-7: no overlongs, surrogates or values above U+10FFFF). Comparison is by codepoint, implemented as byte comparison, which gives the same order for well-formed UTF-8. A constructor for producers that already know the count (the XML parser) can be added later as a new function. string.h is designed but not implemented in Phase 0.
